summary.zh: 划分服务边界并设计韧性的通信方式
summary.en: Set service boundaries and resilient communication

description.zh: 覆盖按业务能力与领域拆分服务、服务间同步与事件驱动通信、分布式数据一致性，以及熔断、重试、限流等韧性手段。适合从单体拆分微服务、设计新服务边界或构建分布式系统时参考。
description.en: Covers splitting services by business capability and domain, sync versus event-driven communication, distributed data consistency, and resilience with circuit breakers, retries, and rate limits. Use it when decomposing a monolith.
